freePlan.limits: Fully free and open source under the PSF license, no paid tier for the language itself

cautions.en: Python itself is free; costs come from hosting, managed runtimes or third-party libraries used alongside it, none of which are set by the Python Software Foundation.

capabilities.en: General-purpose programming language used for web backends, scripts, automation, data analysis and machine learning.
Large standard library and package ecosystem (PyPI) covering web frameworks, data science, testing and more.
Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, and embeds in many other environments.

limitations.en: Slower raw execution speed than compiled languages for CPU-bound workloads.
The Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) limits true multi-threaded CPU parallelism in the standard CPython implementation.

reason.en: Another general-purpose scripting language commonly used for web backends.
Alternative backend framework/runtime (Node.js/TypeScript) for building APIs and services.

missingAlternatives.name: Node.js
missingAlternatives.reason: Major general-purpose runtime competing with Python for backend and scripting use cases, not in the catalogue

missingAlternatives.name: Go
missingAlternatives.reason: Common alternative language for backend services and CLIs, not in the catalogue
